name: retroshelf
summary: Records Knulli play sessions and syncs them to your retroshelf account.

notes: Requires a retroshelf account and Wi-Fi for linking and syncing. Upstream documents offline session queuing and a game-session hook installed on first launch.

Review on 2026-10-24 verified the version-pinned Knulli v0.5.6 ZIP against the publisher checksums.txt and GitHub asset digest: 19393643 compressed bytes, 41864615 regular-file bytes, SHA-256 bb60de30f256e9f187e755b2cc84b6df2ffb6b5d04a2be63f8421fdbec18c8bb. All eight files and four directories were inspected; no packaged code was executed.

Authorized upstream-managed experimental installation follows the Knulli guide: extract into /userdata/roms/tools/retroshelf, register the launcher, then let the user launch and link. First launch installs session hooks. Runtime writes and upstream updates are not sandboxed or checksum-controlled by the Store.

A redistributable license has not been verified. The public release repository links to a source repository that returned HTTP 404 during review. ELF inspection establishes AArch64 and a glibc 2.17 symbol floor for the UI; the sync engine has no dynamic NEEDED entries. The owner confirmed this version tested on TrimUI Smart Pro, Knulli, aarch64, 1280x720 on 2026-10-25. Separate write-containment, preserved-data, hook-ownership and uninstall results were not reported.

The Store links directly to the publisher's release; it does not mirror or redistribute the ZIP. License remains unverified and is disclosed before installation. This exception is limited to upstream-managed experimental packages; no license identifier or device-test result is invented.

Before Store removal, close the app and run /userdata/roms/tools/retroshelf/bin/retroshelf-uninstall.sh --keep-data to remove its hooks while preserving the linked device and sync history. A read-only check of /userdata/system/scripts refuses removal while any hook still references retroshelf. The Store never runs that script or removes shared hooks or runtime-created data.

evidence.note: Owner confirmed all seven current versions tested on TrimUI Smart Pro only. Separate lifecycle steps were not reported.
Documents account linking, offline queuing, Tools installation, session hooks, and uninstall order. Device support is an upstream claim, not Store device-test evidence.
Public release repository at the v0.5.6 tag; README links to https://github.com/ruigomeseu/retroshelf, which still returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-24. No license was verified.

Downloaded ZIP matches the GitHub asset size and SHA-256. Launcher inspection found staged-update application, staged-engine execution, and automatic hook repair. Archive integrity alone does not establish runtime safety.

readelf on the downloaded binaries: ELF64 AArch64. UI NEEDED: SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf, SDL2_gfx, libpthread, libresolv, libc; highest GLIBC symbol 2.17. Only SDL2_gfx is bundled. Sync engine has no dynamic NEEDED entries. Static inspection is not proof of device runtime compatibility.

install.warning: Experimental; license unverified. Owner-tested on TrimUI Smart Pro; other device matrices remain untested. Direct upstream download, not redistributed. App controls hooks and updates. Close app before Store operations; Repair restores pinned code. Before removal run bin/retroshelf-uninstall.sh --keep-data. Account and session data stay.
